title: NoCook — Live SLOs
description: p50/p95/p99 vs SLO for the customer-visible latencies. MEASURED.

panels.title: Case open — cancel commit → case committed
panels.description: Proof label: MEASURED (live Micrometer histograms exported over OTLP, aggregated across replicas with sum by (le)). Clock starts at the OMS commit instant of the cancellation (event occurredAt); stops when the NoCook case transaction has committed (afterCommit). SLO: p99 ≤ 2 s (dashed red). p99 is hidden until N in the last 5 min >= 1000 (below that a p99 is just the max of a handful of samples). Click the p99 line to open slow traces in Tempo.

panels.title: Case open — share ≤ 2 s (5 m)
panels.description: Exact share of case-open observations at or under 2 s in the last 5 min (bucket le="2"). Green at or above 99%. MEASURED.

panels.title: Case open — N (5 m)
panels.description: Number of case-open observations in the last 5 min. MEASURED.

panels.title: Card delivery — case committed → tablet receipt
panels.description: Proof label: MEASURED (live Micrometer histograms exported over OTLP, aggregated across replicas with sum by (le)). Clock starts at cases.opened_at (case committed); stops when the first DELIVERED receipt per (case, device) reaches NoCook. Human tablet and swarm devices are aggregated. SLO: p99 ≤ 2 s. p99 is hidden until N in the last 5 min >= 1000 (below that a p99 is just the max of a handful of samples). Click the p99 line to open slow traces in Tempo.

panels.title: Card delivery — share ≤ 2 s
panels.description: Share of card deliveries at or under 2 s in the last 5 min (le="2"). MEASURED.

panels.title: Card delivery — N
panels.description: Number of card-delivery observations in the last 5 min. MEASURED.

panels.title: ACK API — request → response
panels.description: Proof label: MEASURED (live Micrometer histograms exported over OTLP, aggregated across replicas with sum by (le)). Clock starts when the ACK HTTP request enters the NoCook server and stops when the response leaves (Spring http.server.requests, uri="/api/cases/{caseId}/ack", server-side only; excludes network and nginx). SLO: p99 < 300 ms. p99 is hidden until N in the last 5 min >= 1000 (below that a p99 is just the max of a handful of samples). Click the p99 line to open slow traces in Tempo.

panels.title: ACK API — share < 300 ms
panels.description: Share of ACK requests at or under 300 ms in the last 5 min (le="0.3"). MEASURED.

panels.title: ACK API — N
panels.description: Number of ACK requests in the last 5 min. MEASURED.

panels.title: Timer lateness — due → escalation committed (by kind)
panels.description: Proof label: MEASURED (live Micrometer histograms exported over OTLP, aggregated across replicas with sum by (le)). Clock starts at deadlines.due_at; stops when the escalation transaction commits (DeadlineWorker). p99 is drawn per kind (L1, IVR, EXPIRY); p50/p95 are across all kinds. SLO: p99 ≤ 3 s. p99 is hidden until N in the last 5 min >= 1000 (below that a p99 is just the max of a handful of samples). Click the p99 line to open slow traces in Tempo.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, kind) (rate(nocook_deadline_lateness_seconds_bucket[1m]))) and on() (sum(increase(nocook_deadline_lateness_seconds_count[5m])) >= 1000)

panels.title: Timer lateness — share ≤ 3 s
panels.description: Share of deadlines processed at or under 3 s late in the last 5 min (le="3"). MEASURED.

panels.title: Timer lateness — N
panels.description: Number of deadlines processed in the last 5 min. MEASURED.

panels.title: ACK fan-out — ACK committed → device dismissed
panels.description: Proof label: MEASURED (live Micrometer histograms exported over OTLP, aggregated across replicas with sum by (le)). Clock starts at cases.acked_at (ACK committed); stops when each device reports a DISMISSED receipt (CLOSE, reason ACKNOWLEDGED). SLO: p99 ≤ 2 s. p99 is hidden until N in the last 5 min >= 1000 (below that a p99 is just the max of a handful of samples). Click the p99 line to open slow traces in Tempo.

panels.title: ACK fan-out — share ≤ 2 s
panels.description: Share of ACK fan-outs at or under 2 s in the last 5 min (le="2"). MEASURED.

panels.title: ACK fan-out — N
panels.description: Number of fan-out observations in the last 5 min. MEASURED.

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: MEASURED. Rates over 30 s: cases opened, ACKs applied, broker events consumed (all outcomes), and k6 iterations (load generator side).

panels.title: Broker → NoCook queue depth
panels.description: MEASURED. Ready messages in nocook.cancellations (left axis) and consumers attached (right axis). Depth should return to ~0 after a burst; consumers drop when a replica dies or the listener is paused.

panels.title: Backlogs
panels.description: MEASURED. Outbox rows pending dispatch and deadlines overdue. Target is 0; the dashed red line marks the first pending item.

panels.title: Open cases
panels.description: MEASURED. Cases currently in an open (unacknowledged) state, sampled from the database every 5 s.

panels.title: Background broker load
panels.description: MEASURED. Synthetic non-cancellation events per second the mock OMS firehose actually achieves into the broker (background load, so NoCook must filter in a busy exchange).
